# Feature: Alarm tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #38 (Alarm tile) from Enemies and Bots before it is used in real levels. Effect: stepping on it wakes all sleepers. Unique: a floor tile that activates enemies room-wide. Useful: a mistake to avoid, or a lure to trigger on purpose. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** stepping on it wakes all sleepers.

**So that** a mistake to avoid, or a lure to trigger on purpose.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Alarm tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-38-alarm-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: the direct floor to the orb is an alarm tile, with a longer way round. A player who takes the direct floor wakes the room's sleepers across their exit and restarts, which teaches that some floor is a trigger and that the long way round was the route. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Stepping on it rings once and wakes every sleeper in the room immediately, then it becomes inert floor
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It does not wake sleepers in other rooms

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Alarm tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-38-alarm-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/enemies-and-bots.yml mechanic #38.
